messages:
rachael: Hey all, planning travel for the SF offsite week of June 14. Any budget hotel recs near SoMa? Also opinions: red-eye vs morning flights?
jae: Hilton on 3rd is fine and close to the venue. Not fancy but walkable.
miguel: I take red-eyes to save a day, but I am slow the next morning. Bring caffeine.
priya: Red-eye works for me. Pack ear plugs and an eye mask.
tom: Marriott on 4th sometimes has points availability if anyone is using rewards.
lila: Note that SFO to SoMa can be 30-60 min depending on traffic. BART is cheaper but a walk with bags.
rachael: Good call. Would people want to coordinate a shared Lyft from SFO if arrival times match? I can make a doc.
miguel: I will share my flight times once the doc is up. Happy to split rides.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel expenses within 30 days. See Finance travel policy.
priya: If you need a visa letter, ping People Ops and they will help.
rachael: Thanks everyone, I will post the doc link tonight with hotel options and a simple poll for flight preferences.
